working_definition: Organ-name label for cells of testis origin found in fat body and body wall analyses; authors' term FBbt:00004928 testis (an organ).
justification: The authors' term is an organ. The only cell-level testis terms are 'somatic cell of testis' (FBbt:00006031), which excludes germline cells, and specific types; there is no generic cell-of-testis term covering both germline and somatic cells. Held per curator rule B.

other_candidates.reason_rejected: Organ/structure term; cluster relation requires a cell term.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: A(n) somatic cell that is part of a(n) testis.
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Excludes germline cells, which the label does not exclude.
